items.title: Multilingual Support Now Available
items.body: This site now supports **six languages** (Japanese, Easy Japanese, English, Chinese, Vietnamese, and Korean). You can switch languages from the "Language" menu in the top right. See the [Accessibility Policy](/accessibility) for details.

items.title: Disaster drill announcement
items.body:
A community disaster drill will be held on the first Saturday of September.

See [evacuation info](/evacuation) for details.
